d:
Listen to “Dheere Dheere Machal Ae Dil-E-Beqarar”, the timeless romantic song from the 1966 film Anupama, beautifully sung by the legendary Lata Mangeshkar. Featuring Surekha Pandit and Tarun Bose, this evergreen classic captures the beauty of old Bollywood romance through its soulful melody and heartfelt expression.
